title: Add an optional seed parameter for reproducible sampling
agentPrompt: Add an optional seed parameter to the chat completion request so callers can get reproducible sampling. Follow whatever versioning and test conventions this repo uses.
whyItLooksFine: Because it is fine. This is the control case.
whatIsActuallyWrong: Nothing. The field is optional with a default, the version registry entry lands in the same change, and the contract test gains an assertion about the new shape. A tool that cannot say 'this is ready' is not a review tool, it is a brake — and a brake gets disabled. This scenario is the false-positive guard for the other three.
